addresses.description: Unique 64-bit ROM code: 8-bit family code (28h), 48-bit serial number, 8-bit CRC.

read_channels.notes: Temperature data from scratchpad bytes 0 and 1 (LSB first).

access_model.notes: 1-Wire protocol implemented via GPIO bit-banging with precise timing.

steps.notes: Master pulls DQ low for at least 480 µs (reset pulse).
Master releases bus and waits for presence pulse: DS18B20 waits 15-60 µs then pulls low for 60-240 µs.

operation_flows.notes: Initialization sequence: master sends reset pulse, DS18B20 responds with presence pulse.

preconditions: Device must be addressed via ROM command if multiple devices on bus.

steps.notes: If parasite power, enable strong pullup within 10 µs for duration of conversion.
Wait for conversion time (93.75ms to 750ms depending on resolution; default 12-bit = 750ms).
Read scratchpad to get temperature data.

transaction.notes: Read 2 bytes of temperature data (LSB first).

operation_flows.notes: Initiate temperature conversion and read result.

transaction.notes: Write 3 bytes: TH, TL, configuration (LSB first).

steps.notes: Master sends three data bytes to scratchpad.

operation_flows.notes: Write TH, TL, and configuration registers to scratchpad.

steps.notes: If parasite power, enable strong pullup within 10 µs for at least 10ms.
Wait for NV write cycle time (tWR = 10ms max).

operation_flows.notes: Copy scratchpad TH, TL, configuration to EEPROM.

transaction.notes: Read time slots to check status: 0 while recall in progress, 1 when done.
Read time slot: parasite powered devices pull bus low; externally powered let bus remain high.

operation_flows.notes: Determine if DS18B20 is parasite powered.

steps.notes: Perform data exchange to learn ROM codes; repeat as needed.

operation_flows.notes: Identify all slave devices on the bus by their ROM codes.
Read ROM code of a single slave device.

transaction.notes: Send 64-bit ROM code of target device (LSB first).

steps.notes: Master sends 8 bytes of ROM code.

operation_flows.notes: Address a specific slave device by its ROM code.
Address all devices on the bus simultaneously.

steps.notes: Perform data exchange to identify devices with alarm flag.

operation_flows.notes: Identify devices with alarm flag set.

raw_encoding.notes: Temperature register: 2 bytes, LSB first; 12-bit resolution default; sign bits in bits 15-11.

registers_or_commands.name: Temperature Register LSB
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 0 of scratchpad, LSB of temperature data.

registers_or_commands.name: Temperature Register MSB
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 1 of scratchpad, MSB of temperature data.

registers_or_commands.name: TH Register
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 2 of scratchpad, high alarm trigger register (nonvolatile EEPROM).

registers_or_commands.name: TL Register
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 3 of scratchpad, low alarm trigger register (nonvolatile EEPROM).

registers_or_commands.name: Configuration Register
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 4 of scratchpad, configures resolution via R0 and R1 bits.

registers_or_commands.name: Scratchpad CRC
registers_or_commands.description: Byte 8 of scratchpad, CRC for bytes 0-7.

bitfields.name: Sign bits (S)
bitfields.description: Sign extension bits; S=0 for positive, S=1 for negative.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up default: 12-bit resolution, alarm registers loaded from EEPROM. No explicit bus traffic required.
Initialization sequence: master sends reset pulse (low >= 480 µs), then waits for presence pulse.

read_sequence.notes: To read temperature: issue Convert T (0x44), wait conversion time, then issue Read Scratchpad (0xBE) and read 2 bytes.

timing_constraints.name: tSPON
timing_constraints.condition: After Convert T or Copy Scratchpad command

timing_constraints.name: tRDV
timing_constraints.condition: Read data valid after falling edge

conversion_formulae.name: temp_conversion
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

error_conditions.condition: Presence pulse not detected after reset
error_conditions.detection: Master does not receive presence pulse within tPDHIGH + tPDLOW window.
Calculated CRC of bytes 0-7 does not match byte 8.
error_conditions.driver_action: Retry read operation; if persistent, return -EIO.

error_conditions.detection: If using external supply, read time slots indicate conversion still in progress beyond tCONV.

power_states.name: idle
power_states.description: Low-power idle state after power-up or after conversion complete.

power_states.name: converting
power_states.notes: Active current up to 1.5 mA during conversion.

evidence_spans.snippet: The DS18B20 output temperature data is calibrated in degrees Celsius; for Fahrenheit applications, a lookup table or conversion routine must be used.
The temperature data is stored as a 16-bit sign-extended two's complement number in the temperature register
Byte 4 of the scratchpad memory contains the configuration register
The user can set the conversion resolution of the DS18B20 using the R0 and R1 bits in this register as shown in Table 2.
This command initiates a single temperature conversion.
This command allows the master to read the contents of the scratchpad.
All communication with the DS18B20 begins with an initialization sequence that consists of a reset pulse from the master followed by a presence pulse from the DS18B20.
Temperature Conversion Time: 9-bit resolution: 93.75 ms, 10-bit: 187.5 ms, 11-bit: 375 ms, 12-bit: 750 ms

requires_human: CRC polynomial implementation details for scratchpad and ROM verification
Exact bit-banging implementation for 1-Wire timing (e.g., precise delays for read/write slots)
Parasite power strong pullup MOSFET circuit design
If non-default resolution is desired, the configuration register must be written before conversion; current flow assumes default 12-bit resolution.
